name: JSON Canvas
description: View and edit Obsidian-compatible .canvas boards in Orca: cards, notes, images, groups and connections, with the same look, navigation and file format.

settings.title: Extra vault folders
settings.placeholder: One absolute folder per line. Only needed when a vault is not an Orca workspace.

cover.alt: A Riverside pavilion canvas in dark mode: Markdown notes, SVG image cards, colored groups, labelled connections, a table and a callout.

screenshots.alt: Editing a Markdown card in place, with a wiki link completion popup listing notes from the vault.
screenshots.caption: Edit cards with live Markdown preview and [[note]] suggestions.

screenshots.alt: Dragging a new connection from one card to another, shown as a curved arrow across two groups.
screenshots.caption: Drag from a card's edge dot to connect it to another card.

screenshots.alt: Two selected cards with the color palette open above them, in light mode.
screenshots.caption: Select, arrange and color cards, in light or dark mode.

screenshots.alt: The note picker open over a canvas, listing vault notes and canvases to add as cards.
screenshots.caption: Add notes and media from your local vault.
